name: Bray
title: Hostler of the Ford Stable
examine: Smells of oats, saddle soap, and patience. He is having a quiet argument with a horse, and losing on points.
lines: Twenty years droving and my horse retired me. Got off at the ford one spring, and he declined to leave. So here we both are.
Beasts fed before riders. Riders argue less. That's the whole philosophy of the yard.
A road horse knows the High Road better than half the folk walking it. Trust the ears. The ears are never wrong.
